description: How to add or remove a required status check on `main` yourself, instead of asking a human to click through repo settings. Use this whenever a task means changing the `protect-main` ruleset — "make the Marketing site check required", "add a PR check to the ruleset", "gate merges on the API service job" — or diagnosing a PR stuck on "Expected — waiting for status to be reported". Trigger it the moment you rename a job `name:` or a matrix leg in any `*-pr.yml`, because the ruleset matches checks by exact name and a rename silently orphans the gate. Read it BEFORE hand-rolling `gh api --method PUT .../rulesets/<id>`: that call REPLACES the arrays you send, so a partial payload deletes every other rule on `main`. There is no `gh ruleset edit` — don't go looking for one.
